subject: CarePilot costing follow-up & request for product usage deck
messages:
From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>
To: Emma Li <emma.li@carepilot.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-02-03T16:18:00Z
Subject: Quick recap + ask: token targets and product usage deck

Hi Emma — thanks again for the call earlier. Couple of quick notes to make sure we’re aligned and to get the costing worked up on our side.

Notes from discovery:
- Primary integration: triage assistant inside CarePilot clinician dashboard (API calls per patient session, median prompt length ~180 tokens, average completion length ~220 tokens).
- Expected pilot traffic: 10k MAUs, 0.6 sessions/user/day (peak 2x), estimated 3M generated tokens/month (approx).
- Critical metrics: target feature-level margin >= 55% after infra and Redwood usage fees; target CAC payback <= 9 months for this paid feature.
- Budget band: $/1M tokens target somewhere between $600–$1,200 depending on SLA and burst needs (you mentioned $1k as a rough target in the call).

Asks / next steps from CarePilot:
1) Can you share a short product usage deck (1–2 slides) that shows expected session patterns, peak % of traffic, and any retention assumptions? That will let us map batching/caching opportunities and estimate realistic per-token costs.
2) Confirm whether PII is sent in prompts (yes/no) — affects encryption/KMS and Private deployment pricing.
3) Any procurement timing or PO cadence we should know about?

I’ve CC’d Ben to draft a tight cost scenario once we get the deck — we’ll produce a short pro-forma that shows $/feature at 3 token-volume tiers (1M / 3M / 10M) and the implied CAC payback given your ARPU assumption.

If you prefer, we can do a 30m follow-up next week to walk through the pro-forma — available Tue/Wed afternoon PT.

Cheers,
Olga Petrov
Senior Sales Manager | Redwood Inference
Mobile: +1 (415) 555-0147

Attachment stubs: redwood-costing-notes-olga.pdf (internal costing assumptions)
From: Emma Li <emma.li@carepilot.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-02-04T09:02:00Z
Subject: Re: Quick recap + ask: token targets and product usage deck

Thanks Olga — appreciated the recap.

Answers inline:
1) Deck: yes, attaching a 2-slide product brief (also paste below).
2) PII: prompts will contain limited PHI (patient first/last name redacted in most cases; MRN hashed). We’ll need SOC2 + audit log detail.
3) Procurement: we usually do a one-time pilot PO (60–90 day) and then a contract for production if pilot meets KPIs. Finance reviews pilot PO range $10k–$30k.

Two clarifications on volume: the 3M tokens figure is our conservative baseline — if clinician rollout is faster (beta to full pilot), we could see up to 8–9M tokens/month. Peak hours are typically 9–11am ET and 2–4pm ET (about 28% of daily traffic).

Available for Tue afternoon PT for a walkthrough.

—Emma
VP Product, CarePilot
Attachments: CarePilot_ProductBrief_v2.pdf
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-02-06T13:45:00Z
Subject: RE: Quick recap + ask: token targets and product usage deck

Team — reviewed Emma’s deck and chat notes. Draft pro-forma approach (high level):

Assumptions we should run (Ben bullets):
- Model selection: open LLM v2-medium equiv for pilot; consider quantized variant for production to lower $/token ~20–30%.
- Effective tokens per request = prompt (180) + generation (220) = 400 tokens roundtrip.
- Batching / KV cache: for clinician templates we can expect 12–18% effective token savings using prefix caching and shared templates.
- Peak-sla uplift: add 18% overhead for burst capacity (reserve) if they require <200ms p95.

Scenarios to deliver in pro-forma (we’ll attach spreadsheet):
1) Baseline (3M tokens/mo): raw cost, Redwood hosted price @ $X per 1M tokens (we will propose), margin % vs target 55%.
2) Upside (8M–9M tokens/mo): show improved unit economics and lower $/1M with reserved capacity + quantization.
3) Aggressive pilot (10M+): show CAC payback sensitivity if they convert 5–8% to paid users at ARPU assumptions.

Action items for Olga: pull any ARPU/paid-conversion assumptions CarePilot has (or we’ll show a range). I’ll prepare redwood-pro forma-1M-token-scenarios.xlsx and a short slide with recommended starting $/1M tokens to propose (we typically start with a concierge pilot price then step down as volume commits increase).

Ben
Head of Commercial Operations | Redwood Inference
From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>
To: Emma Li <emma.li@carepilot.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, CarePilot Finance <finance@carepilot.com>
Date: 2026-02-10T15:05:00Z
Subject: Re: Quick recap + ask: token targets and product usage deck — pro-forma attached

Emma — attaching the pro-forma and a short notes PDF. Highlights:
- Pilot proposal: 60-day pilot, up to 4M tokens total, pilot price $950 / 1M tokens (applies to used tokens). We’ll absorb initial integration engineering credits up to $5k.
- Production step: committed tier pricing at 5M+/month: $700 / 1M tokens with a 6-month minimum commit. Quantized private deployment option reduces effective unit cost to ~$520 / 1M tokens (requires Private deployment + KMS).
- Feature-level view: for the triage assistant feature, at baseline 3M tokens/mo, estimated monthly infra + Redwood fees = $2,850; projected feature revenue at $X/user-month -> implied margin ~58% (meets their 55% target in baseline).
- CAC payback sensitivity: assuming paid conversion 6% and ARPU $19/mo, payback is 8–10 months depending on pilot-to-prod conversion.

Next steps:
1) Emma — please confirm whether CarePilot can sign a pilot PO in the $10k–$25k window and whether SOC2 attestation is required before pilot start.
2) Finance — if OK, we’ll prepare a short sOW and invoice template.
3) Schedule: propose Wed Feb 11, 11:00am PT for a 30m pricing walkthrough (link below).

Thanks — I’ll be on the call with Ben and Marissa to walk the pro-forma.

Olga Petrov
Senior Sales Manager | Redwood Inference
Attachment stubs: redwood-pro forma-1M-token-scenarios.xlsx, redwood-costing-notes-olga.pdf
